project: Project Sagar — 2D Fighting Game Animation Production

animations.name: Standing Light Punch
animations.animation_purpose: Fast jab poke for interrupting opponents, pressure checks, and starting light chains.
animations.start_and_recovery_pose_notes: Starts from neutral standing fighting guard (F1), peaks at crisp straight lead-fist contact (F3), and recovers directly into neutral standing guard (F4).
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); both bare feet stay grounded with slight forward weight transfer on F2-F3.

animations.name: Standing Heavy Punch
animations.animation_purpose: High-damage, weight-driven rear straight/haymaker for punishes and heavy combo enders.
animations.start_and_recovery_pose_notes: Starts from stable standing guard (F1), winds back deeply (F2), lunges into full impact (F4) with follow-through (F5), and recovers to standing guard (F6).
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); front bare foot anchors heavy forward lunge while rear heel lifts on impact.

animations.name: Standing Light Kick
animations.animation_purpose: Quick mid-low front snap kick for spacing control and fast hit-confirms.
animations.start_and_recovery_pose_notes: Starts from standing guard (F1), shifts weight (F2) and chambers knee (F3), snaps kick forward (F4), and retracts cleanly to standing guard (F5).
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); rear supporting bare foot remains firmly planted on ground_y throughout kick.

animations.name: Standing Heavy Kick
animations.animation_purpose: Long-range high-impact roundhouse/side kick for heavy neutral pokes and knockback.
animations.start_and_recovery_pose_notes: Starts from standing guard (F1), pivots and chambers high (F2-F4), extends full high kick rightward (F5), retracts (F6), and lands back in standing guard (F7).
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); supporting foot anchors firmly while torso counter-leans left during F5 impact.

animations.name: Crouching Low Punch
animations.animation_purpose: Fast crouching jab for low-profile pressure, tick throws, and close-range interrupts.
animations.start_and_recovery_pose_notes: Starts and ends in low crouching guard (F1, F4) with shoulder coil (F2) and crisp horizontal crouch-punch contact (F3).
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); maintains consistent crouched height and planted feet across all 4 frames.

animations.name: Crouching Low Kick
animations.animation_purpose: Quick low-hitting shin/ankle poke from crouch to force low blocks.
animations.start_and_recovery_pose_notes: Starts from crouching guard (F1), shifts weight onto rear leg (F2), snaps low kick out (F3-F4), and retracts to crouching guard (F5).
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); rear crouched foot stays anchored while kicking leg extends low near floor.

animations.name: Sweep Attack
animations.animation_purpose: Traditional fighting-game knockdown low sweep with distinct ground-skimming reach.
animations.start_and_recovery_pose_notes: Drops from guard (F1-F2), coils and rotates low (F3-F4), extends full floor-skimming sweep with hand brace (F5), retracts (F6), and recovers (F7).
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); supporting leg and bracing hand anchor low ground contact on F5.

animations.name: Anti-Air Uppercut
animations.animation_purpose: Dedicated upward anti-air punch to stuff jumping opponents.
animations.start_and_recovery_pose_notes: Starts from standing guard (F1), coils deep low (F2), drives vertically upward (F3) to full skyward uppercut impact (F4) and apex follow-through (F5), landing into guard (F6).
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); F4-F5 vertical arm reach fits cleanly inside 288x288 cell with zero top clipping.

animations.name: Jumping Punch
animations.animation_purpose: Fast aerial forward punch for air-to-air exchanges and jump-in combo starters.
animations.start_and_recovery_pose_notes: Starts in Batch 1 airborne tucked posture (F1), winds shoulder mid-air (F2), extends crisp aerial punch (F3-F4), and returns to airborne descent posture (F5).
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Airborne center-balanced pivot within 288x288 cell; both feet stay completely off ground across all 5 frames.

animations.name: Jumping Kick
animations.animation_purpose: Deep-reaching flying aerial kick for jump-in pressure and cross-up approaches.
animations.start_and_recovery_pose_notes: Starts in airborne prep (F1), chambers knee (F2), thrusts leg forward-downward (F3) to full flying kick contact (F4), and retracts to airborne recovery (F5).
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Airborne center-balanced pivot within 288x288 cell; no ground contact during sequence.
